description: This Java class acts as an event listener that reacts to successful authentication events within a Spring Security context. When a user successfully authenticates, it resets their failed login attempt count if necessary.

classes.name: AuthenticationSuccessListener
classes.description: A Spring component that listens for successful authentication events and resets the user's failed login attempts if the user exists and has previously failed login attempts.

methods.name: onApplicationEvent
methods.description: Handles the event fired upon a successful user authentication. Retrieves the user by email and resets failed login attempts if necessary.

methods.name: AuthenticationSuccessListener
methods.description: Constructor that injects the UserService dependency.
